text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Angolan Defence Minister Pedro Sebasiao and his Portuguese counterpart Antonio Vitorino held talks ahead of signing a military cooperation agreement on Thursday.

- UNITA's Abel Chivukuvuku arrived in Luanda for continued talks with the government on military and political issues and said UNITA Jonas Savimbi would not attend the Southern African Development Community summit in Luanda on Wednesday.
- The eastern province of Moxico has been linked to the rest of the country with the opening of a bridge over the Cassai River into Lunda Sul province.
